reviews.reasons: CONDITIONAL is the right family (price, demand, conversion and volume are unknowns only selling measures; spend fits: $37 Instantly + 9 x $49 = $478 <= $500; 9 x $600 = $5,400 collected by day 28 inside 30 days; buyers limited to commercial print shops). But it cannot run as written. (1) The test takes buyers' money before fulfilment is shown possible: the offer invoices $600 'paid before work starts' from day 2, while Brain's FULFILMENT link is false and the card's fulfillment fact is only a RECOMMENDATION. theStacc's page (which I opened) sells a $49/mo self-serve Local SEO plan with '30 planned Google posts a month' and review-reply drafts, but nothing shows it can be bought and operated by a third party on a shop's profile, or that it covers 'profile optimization' and a monthly report; one $49 subscription run on a real listing before the first invoice would show it inside the spend cap. (2) The proof gate does not carry the target at its threshold: it continues on 2 paid of 300 by day 12 (0.67%), but the target needs 9 of 300 (3%), and the reach step already sends the whole 300-shop list on day 2, so 'keep sending to the remaining list' has no remaining list; at the gate's own rate the plan collects about $1,200. The gate should be the rate that yields 9 sales (e.g. >= 4-5 paid of 300 by day 12 with a named second list and its cost), or the stop must fire below it. One defect remains, and it is in the gate the owner acts on: the offer invoices each shop 'only after the first week's work is live', but the ledger books shop 1 paid on day 9 and shops 2-5 paid days 10-12, and the day-12 gate requires 'the first delivery worked and was paid'. strategy.title: Sell Google Business Profile setup + first month of management to independent commercial print shops by cold email, fulfilled on theStacc's print-shop Local SEO module
strategy.why: It sells only to commercial print shops, a vendor publishes exactly this service for printing and sign shops (self-serve $49/mo, managed from $749/mo) and states agencies quote print shops $800-$2,500/mo, so a $600 setup+month undercuts both; fulfilment costs $49 per shop and is bought only after the shop pays, so total spend is $37 + 9 x $49 = $478 within the $500.
